name: SilberLand
english_description: SilberLand, an Austrian-German LPMud of MorgenGrauen lineage, welcoming adventurers with the Silver Streak ASCII skyline at the famous Adventurers' Guild (Die beruehmte Abenteurergilde), connecting upward to Das juengste Geruecht and westward into Midas city's Hauptstrasse, chapel, Zur roten Nase tavern and dining hall, general store, post office, iron gate toward the church, and side streets toward the town hall.
